svg.title: Study Buddy wiring harnesses
svg.desc: Three Dupont ribbon harnesses. Display: orange SCL row 4, yellow SDA row 5, green RST row 6, blue DC row 7, brown GND row 8, purple CS row 9, gray BL row 10, row 3 (GND) empty, red VCC to 3V3 pin 36. Amplifier: purple BCLK row 12, brown GND row 13, blue LRC row 14, gray DIN row 15, white GAIN row 16, black SD wire removed, red Vin to VBUS pin 40. Microphone: gray SCK row 17, brown GND and black L/R row 18, white WS row 19, orange SD row 20, red VDD to 3V3 pin 36.
svg.text: Study Buddy Wiring Harnesses: module end (top) to breadboard row (bottom)
1. Display harness: 8 wires, brown to gray
Module end: original ribbon order. Pico end: red goes to 3V3; brown moves between blue and purple to GND row 8.
2. Amplifier harness: blue to red, black wire removed
Module end: original order. Pico end: purple and blue swap, and brown moves between them to GND row 13.
3. Microphone harness: 6 wires, gray to orange, folded in a U
Module end: drawn unfolded; on the board the strip wraps around both pin rows. Pico end: white moves past black and brown.
